paragraphs: In pod NA79CA, Lea, Ana and Bo set out to close the operator's first residual gap: give every settlement a USA equivalent that arrives by a traceable route — a dated, sourced exchange rate…, and closed one synchronized session against the measurable outcome they set: docs/asks/2026-09-12_fx_to_usd.psv grows from 1 row to 29 — one per currency the 120 settling places use, each carrying Units per USD, an As-of date…. Whether it was met is for the record and the witnesses below, not for this summary. They recorded it in written words, so the outcome is evidence a settlement can stand on, not a claim taken on trust. In their own words, the pod noted: "Dated exchange-rate file drafted — currency, units per USD, as-of date, named source — stamped 2026-09-12.…".

Because the work was witnessed, 0.0138 cross-reviewed hours settled as 0.066 웃, computed as M times hours, with M of 4.81, and each person is bound by the 9,999-per-year ceiling with the rest rolling forward. The pod finished 2.9862 hours inside its 3.0000-hour frozen baseline, but the conditions for a bonus were not all confirmed, so no ◬ were recognised; the accelerator reads the hours delta only, never a profit metric. Nothing new was minted; the pod only gated ♡, 웃, and ◬ that already exist. Where a capability is not yet lawful in a place, it fails closed rather than falling over.

The outcome now feeds the backlog, where this pod, or the next, can adopt the following Task and Outcome from the same three projects and carry the thread forward. Measurement of Time keeps every actual minute on the append-only ledger, apart from the 웃 that settled, so the whole session replays exactly as it happened. Where the work grows a project's financial-innovation, the Qualified Innovation Score measures it and its growth sizes the reward pool — a measurement, never a second mint. The reward pool is sized by qualified growth after qualification, and it mints no token by itself. Recognition is not money, and qualification is not conversion.
